items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was working with Cab Calloway or somebody. I can’t remember with whom he was playing, but he had left.

ctx.x: J.C. Heard, was he around then?
No, he’d left. He was working with Cab Calloway or somebody. I can’t remember with whom he was playing, but he had left.
Was there evidence of Betty Carter or whatever her name was at that time?
